title: Browser Matrix, Performance, And Proof Artifact Pipeline
scope: Run repeatable Chromium WebGPU gating check on canonical preview runtime
Capture machine-readable readiness and frame-time baseline
Treat optional non-blocking browser telemetry lanes as informational only

verification.command: osascript Safari probe for Boolean(navigator.gpu) + webgpu context
verification.notes: Real Safari (Version 26.3) reports navigator.gpu=true and canvas.getContext('webgpu')=true in this environment. This is telemetry only and non-blocking.

notes: Readiness gate enforcement is Chromium-only by policy; optional WebKit telemetry remains non-blocking.
Headless WebKit GPU availability is environment-dependent and does not delay readiness.
